rdf:Description.vaem:rationale: The notion of a SKOS concept is useful when describing the conceptual or intellectual structure of a knowledge organization system, and when referring to specific ideas or meanings established within a KOS.
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An idea or notion; a unit of thought.
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: concept
rdf:Description.skos:note: Note that, because SKOS is designed to be a vehicle for representing semi-formal KOS, such as thesauri and classification schemes, a certain amount of flexibility has been built in to the formal definition of this class.
